# #155 Become a coach from onboarding, with clearer Settings wording
## Parent
#153
## What to build
Someone who signed up without a code can become a coach without finishing the lifter intake. The onboarding screen offers "I'm a coach — enter invite code", which redeems an owner-issued, account-bound coach invite and takes them straight to Coach mode. The Settings entry for redeeming a coach invite is also relabelled to say what it does, because it currently reads "Connect to a coach". Decisions: spec #153 (Q2).
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The onboarding screen shows an "I'm a coach — enter invite code" entry that redeems through the existing coach-invite redeem call. On success the account has the coach capability and lands in Coach mode, skipping intake. An invalid code shows the redeem error and keeps them on onboarding. - [ ] The Settings redeem entry reads "Enable coaching", with the subtitle "Redeem an owner-issued coach code" (or equivalent wording that clearly means becoming a coach, not joining one). Its visibility is unchanged. - [ ] Joining a coach (the assignment invite on the Coaching assignment screen) is unchanged. - [ ] Widget tests through the real app with the fake API: the onboarding entry redeems and lands in Coach mode; an invalid code shows the error; Settings shows the new wording. `flutter analyze` and `flutter test` pass.
## Blocked by
None (can start immediately).
